newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen hovering in limited range.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen hovering in limited range.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are likely to hover in a limited range on Tuesday, as profit-taking pressure is expected to be strong above the Nikkei's 20,500-point level, brokers said.
On Monday, the Nikkei 225 average sprinted 383.04 points higher, or 1.91 percent, to close at 20,451.85. June Nikkei futures jumped 300 to 20,440.
"The Nikkei 225 is likely to see selling pressure close to 20,500 points, and it might cap the index," said Kenji Karikomi, deputy general manager at Daiwa Securities Co Ltd.
Brokers said they did not expect factors such as the currency market or U.S. stocks to provide fresh incentives for Tokyo stocks.
Some said they expect investors to focus on smaller-capital stocks as major blue-chip issues remain in an adjustment phase.
